post.summary: Send a test ticket through the public URL
post.description:
Human administrators only, with an active public endpoint. Helm POSTs
a low-priority generic ticket (`dedupe_key: helm-public-url-test`) to
`https://{hostname}/api/v1/hooks/tickets/probe/{nonce}`; the nonce is
one-time, expires in 30 seconds and is bound to this webhook, so the
hooks listener files the ticket under it with the code real
deliveries use. Success proves an outside app can open tickets
through Cloudflare and the tunnel. A failed round trip is still HTTP
200 with `ok: false` and a `message` explaining the likely cause.
